page_read.result: Both plans answered (status 200, access ok, the hand-filed copy, 653 PDF pages). PDF pp.95-96 print a minimum per Cal-GETC area and no total (quoted in kb/program_requirements_reconcile.json), so the statewide step applies and no set step is needed. A simulation of R.calgetc_hold on the read's printed text of each program's pages, with Cosumnes River's filed siblings, fills all three: 30566's section runs from its own 'Degree Requirements' (p.552, the first in its page window) to the 'Career Information' heading after its outcomes, naming Cal-GETC once with no figure; 33072's and 39656's sections name Cal-GETC with no figure and no Area line. The reconcile run reads the capture's own text, so its trace lines decide.

first_reconcile_note: No Cosumnes River record carries reconciled notes: the reconcile dispatched for this apply is also the college's first reconcile and rescore, and reconcile_filed rescores every record whose page it reads again with no kept-passing guard. After it is filed, run --calgetc-review 'Cosumnes River College' --run RUN --against origin/main --restore: the three apply rows are kept where ge_units alone changed to 34, every other changed record goes back to main whole, and summary.json is recounted before the reread.
